name: Memory Enhanced
description: Brain-inspired four-layer memory system with structured events, knowledge distillation, association traversal, and automated consolidation

halfLifeDays.description: Half-life for exponential decay of event scores (days)

archiveThreshold.description: Events with decay_score below this are archived

memoryMdMaxChars.description: Target maximum character count for auto-generated MEMORY.md

outputCheckpointChars.description: Approximate output length threshold before the long-answer watchdog considers a checkpoint interrupt

outputCheckpointCooldownChars.description: Minimum output distance between checkpoint attempts

outputCheckpointBoundarySlackChars.description: Extra slack allowed while waiting for a sentence or block boundary before interrupting

outputCheckpointMaxInterrupts.description: Maximum number of output checkpoint interrupts allowed in a single reply

outputCheckpointDriftThreshold.description: Drift score threshold that must be crossed before a soft-boundary checkpoint interrupt fires

outputCheckpointTailChars.description: Recent output tail length retained for drift scoring

enableV8GraphRecall.description: Enable the experimental V8 graph-based recall path when .memory/graph/manifest.json exists

enableV8ExplorationNoise.description: Enable very low-frequency exploration noise in the V8 graph: tiny associative edge jitter plus a few weak exploratory associative links

v8ExplorationMode.description: Exploration mode for V8 graph noise: disabled, uniform global randomness, or sparsity-biased exploratory linking

v8ExplorationNewEdgeProbability.description: Per-attempt probability for adding a tiny random associative link during V8 graph build

v8ExplorationWeightJitterProbability.description: Per-edge probability of applying a very small random weight jitter to existing associative edges

v8ExplorationWeightJitterDelta.description: Maximum absolute delta for exploration jitter applied to associative edge weights

v8ExplorationMaxNewEdges.description: Maximum number of weak random associative links added in one V8 graph build

v8ExplorationMinNewEdgeWeight.description: Minimum initial weight for exploration-added weak associative links

v8ExplorationMaxNewEdgeWeight.description: Maximum initial weight for exploration-added weak associative links

v8ClusterDiagnosisMinBuildCount.description: Minimum V8 graph build count before cluster diagnosis/queue pruning starts

v8ClusterDiagnosisMinTotalHits.description: Minimum total node hit count required before cluster diagnosis can start

v8ClusterDiagnosisCooldownMinutes.description: Cooldown window between cluster diagnosis runs to avoid immediate repeated pruning
